up: List all distinct molecules (pref_name and chembl_id) that are reported in the document with chembl_id CHEMBL5725961. Join the molecule records to the activities and then to the documents to find the matching doc_id.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725961'
